column1: {"narrative": "PayPal has arbitrarily and unjustifiably closed my account. They are currently holding {\u0024400.00} of my money and have stated that I will not be able to access these funds for 120 days, without providing any clear explanation, evidence, or specific details regarding the alleged unusual activity. I have complied with all policies, and there has been no fraudulent or suspicious activity on my account. PayPals lack of transparency, the unjustified retention of my funds, and their refusal to provide a proper explanation constitute an abuse of their position and are causing financial harm. I am requesting the immediate release of my funds and a formal explanation for the arbitrary closure of my account."}

{"narrative": "I received a collection notice from AFNI about a bill from XXXX XXXX XXXX ( XXXX ). I contacted them by phone to let them know that i have never had an account with XXXX XXXX XXXX. They advised me to file an identity theft claim. After doing so, I received another letter from AFNI informing me that XXXX XXXX XXXX determined the account to be valid but did not send any proof, other than the letter attached, or their method of validation. Which is unacceptable. I am exercising my rights under FCRA 611 ( a ) ( 7 ) to request a complete description of all validation to investigate this matter. I am absolutely positive this erroneous item does not belong to me and should be removed from my credit report, along with all other files in connection to the account, immediately. \r\n\r\nPlease see attached letters : AFNI collection notice AFNI fraud response"}
